image_description: A low-angle shot of a massive radio telescope dish, viewed from below. The structure features a large, circular parabolic reflector with a solid-looking rim and a complex white steel lattice support structure (truss work) underneath. The dish is tilted upwards against an overcast sky. Dark green foliage from trees frames the bottom left and right corners, providing scale reference.
